# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 79 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 49 | Coptic

---

## Saying 79

**1** A woman in the crowd called out to him: "How blessed is the womb that carried you and the breasts that fed you!" He said to her: "Blessed rather are those who have heard the word of the Father and truly kept it. For days are coming when people will say: 'Blessed is the womb that never conceived and the breasts that never nursed.'"

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Called out to him" — more vivid than "said to him" for a crowd setting
- "Blessed rather" — the redirecting contrast is made explicit
- "Days are coming" — more immediate than "there will be days"
- "Never conceived / never nursed" — the eschatological reversal as total negation
